finalMessage:
Implemented shipping in the quote and charged total: free when the discounted subtotal is at least 100.00; otherwise 5.99.

All 37 tests pass. `ostf check --base main` passes with 114 valid links.

Trace impact: `R-SHIPPING`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-TAX-RATE`. Added draft `R-SHIPPING`, linked to `N-FAIR-PRICE`, `price`, and the new shipping checkout test.

Impacted tests passed: Checkout suite, shipping thresholds, places an order; price suite, taxes the subtotal after discounts; tax rounds half up to the cent.
